name: DPCLock claimToken pays DPC at manipulable spot quotes
summary: DPCLock.claimToken computes its unlock multiple and the DPC payout from PancakeRouter getAmountsOut spot quotes on the FSP/USDT and FSP/DPC pairs: the FSP pool value and a USDT->FSP->DPC conversion. With flash-loaned USDT, attackers skewed those pairs, locked FSP through swapDPC, and called claimToken for inflated DPC amounts, which they sold back through the pairs. The first attacker did this twice; two copycats repeated it in the next two blocks.

loss.notes: Exact DPC depletion of DPCLock 0xc697e28f2fc7b8d6734d8d91cb280e99067ebde3 over five campaign transactions, valued at the USDT the campaign pulled out of the FSP/USDT pair 0x7c1f8f5d8d000b00a2eaa3c21071dbca18f6825d, where the stolen DPC was sold. DPC has no independent market quote: spot implies about 200,000 USD per DPC against a 23-DPC pool. Flash-loan legs net out within each transaction.

ageReset.description: Direct, non-upgradeable DPCLock runtime. The owner's setTokenContract calls (DPC, staking, FSP/DPC pair) and setOldLockData migrations are ordinary wiring and position imports; the spot-quote pricing is in the code from deployment.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 (block 67346529, index 1) is a contract creation by 0x4a5997b37d6afe1880d995d61b7fb843ae616c77. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): attack contract 0xbddf11ee80b52adb012423cce09a375ed0954022 skews the pairs with flash-loaned USDT, then calls DPCLock 0xc697e28f swapDPC(88222.0438602558 FSP) (0x5195fd2e) and claimToken() (0x4451d89f). Inside claimToken, DPCLock STATICCALLs router getAmountsOut (0xd06ca61f) for FSP->USDT on the FSP/DPC pair's FSP balance, USDT->FSP and FSP->DPC. Source-7 (verified DPCLock) derives unLockC from that FSP value, claimAmountUSDT from _totalLockedUSDT and the payout MaxAmountDPC from the two spot conversions, and transfers it with no TWAP or bound. swapDPC also records _totalLockedUSDT from a DPC->FSP->USDT spot quote. Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at 67291034; keccak 0xe82cf76af944d42aca3fecd7b585792125b695f18c214028290bf0af88946460 (16218 bytes) at 67291035 and 67346528. Source-8 (block 67291035, index 0) is the top-level creation by 0x57cc4ec7798024d49744cabb482fbc1c71d793bd. The owner's only other txs before source-1 are setTokenContract (0x42a6112b: DPC 0x6f6243b8, staking 0x21a01806 then 0x34c8ee19, pair 0xa43cf2ad) and setOldLockData (0x21a6ad8f) at blocks 67291218..67292499; there is no upgrade path. Earliest exercise: Etherscan tokentx of DPCLock through block 67500000 (1935 transfers) shows DPC leaving DPCLock only to ecosystem 0xcb39e106 and technical 0xf9276441 (1% fees on swapDPC) until source-1. The next non-fee DPC outflows are the campaign transactions and a 0.000074757342348977 DPC claim in 0x4b48ae96381d0be5aa21e09fd776255a74c1dda3d41eaff1eff153b3260933f8 (block 67348232), which leaves the FSP/USDT pair untouched.

Verified DPCLock source: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=56 for 0xc697e28f2fc7b8d6734d8d91cb280e99067ebde3 (single-file standard JSON, pragma ^0.8.20). Inspect claimToken (poolAmount = staking total + getCurrentPrice(FSP, USDT, FSP balance of _uniswapV2Pair); MaxAmountFSP = getCurrentPrice(USDT, FSP, claimAmountUSDT); MaxAmountDPC = getCurrentPrice(FSP, DPC, MaxAmountFSP)) and getCurrentPrice (router.getAmountsOut spot).
